text: Students, if you are sinning, stop. Ask God to forgive you.
Sin is a deadly snake with lion's fangs. Stay away! If you come close you will be bitten.
Lawlessness kills like a sword with two edges swung this way and that.
If you are too shy or proud and arrogant, you can lose your wealth and even your home.
The prayers of the poor go straight to God's ear, and he quickly answers.
If you hate correction, you will become a sinner, but if you take it to heart, you will obey the Lord.
Good speakers can be famous, but people with common sense will catch every mistake.
Borrowing to build your house is like gathering stones to mark your own grave.
A meeting of evil people is a bundle of straw, where a small flame ends in a blazing fire.
For a sinner, the road of life is smooth, but it slopes down to the world of the dead.
Fear the Lord in every way, and you will become wise; Control your thoughts, and you can obey his Law.
You have to be smart to learn, but some kinds of smartness only make other people bitter.
The knowledge of the wise is an overflowing river, and their advice is a life-giving spring.
The mind of a fool is a leaking jar that holds nothing for long.
When the wise hear a proverb, they give it praise and add more to it; but fools merely laugh and forget it.
Listening to a fool is tiring, like carrying a heavy backpack on a journey, but listening to someone smart is refreshing.
In a town meeting, people look for some common sense, and when they hear it, they will think about what was said.
Knowledge means nothing to ignorant fools, and wisdom is useless as a burned-down house.
Fools think learning puts chains on their hands and feet,
and they laugh at it loudly. But smart people just smile,
because they know that learning is a golden bracelet.
Fools will push past you into your home, but the wise will wait at your door. *
They are polite and will not try to see inside or to hear what is going on,
because that would be rude and shameful.
Some people won't stop talking about things that are none of their business. But sensible people weigh each word before it is spoken.
In a fool, the mind thinks only after the mouth speaks, but in a wise person, the mind controls the mouth.
The ungodly fall under any curse that they try to place on their enemies.
If you spread gossip, your character will be ruined and your neighbors will hate you.
